name: rein
description: Persistent cross-session memory MCP server with built-in OAuth for remote connectors
long_description:
rein is a self-adaptive memory MCP server for AI agents. Multi-source cross-validated memory with embedding-based semantic dedup, Kaplan-Meier survival decay, knowledge graph (Memoir / Concept / ConceptLink with temporal validity windows), HDBSCAN clustering, and a self-learning loop replacing fixed parameters with learned values. Exposes 40 MCP tools across core memory ops, knowledge graph, temporal recall, adaptive engine, ARS feedback (Cap A mirror, Cap B synthesis, Cap C archival summary), runtime LLM judge, and Trust & Measurement. v0.30 adds an explicit HTTP auth policy and a built-in OAuth provider for Claude Cowork / claude.ai / mobile remote MCP connectors.

This extension targets macOS Apple Silicon. Other platforms: see the project README for the Claude Code plugin marketplace path or `cargo install`.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key
gemini_api_key.description: Required for embeddings (gemini-embedding-001), LLM extraction, query expansion, reranker, and adaptive synthesis. Get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (1500 req/day free tier).

rein_db.title: Memory database path
rein_db.description: Optional. Path to the SQLite database file. Defaults to ~/.rein/memories.db. Override only if you maintain multiple separate memory stores.

supermemory_key.title: Supermemory API Key (optional)
supermemory_key.description: Optional cross-validation source. Leave blank to skip Supermemory hybrid search.
